audit.why: Mel wins levels 1-2 as ranged vs melee, but Irelia's E stun + Q resets from level 3 and her Fervor stacks make every later stage hers at 46.36% WR.

audit.why: Spikes are correctly identified: her level 3 (E+Q resets), her item sustain spike, Mel's Luden's and level 6 Golden Eclipse.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad; missing interactions absent: Irelia Q sustain wants early Grievous Wounds, and her R wall cuts Mel's dash-less retreat.
